entries.en: Seeing the desire for bigger fish in your eyes, Sisipu has given you your greatest challenge yet. With crayfish balls in hand, you are to venture to the Nym River in middle La Noscea and catch a plump and juicy princess trout.

entries.en:
During a heated debate with Wawalago over the proper way to prepare princess trout, Sisipu lets slip that she may have had ulterior motives for sending you to the Nym. Putting that to one side, she states that this task should have shown the importance of perseverance in your trade.

※The next fisher quest will be available from Sisipu upon reaching level 15.

entries.fr:
Lorsque vous lui avez remis votre , Sisipu vous a expliqué que pour attraper de gros poissons, un pêcheur devait savoir choisir son équipement, que ce soit pour l'outillage ou la tenue. Avec ces conseils en tête, continuez de vous exercer en essayant de faire de plus grosses prises.
* Sisipu propose la prochaine quête aux pêcheurs de niveau 15.
entries.ja:
シシプにを納品した。を納品すると、シシプは大物の魚を釣り上げるには、釣り竿と、釣りに臨む衣装を整えることが肝心だと教えてくれた。さまざまな要素に手を抜くことなく、さらなる大物を狙えるよう努力しよう。

※漁師のレベルが15以上になると、シシプから次の漁師クエストを受注することができます。

entries.en: Not that I'm worried about you. Oh yes, I can see it. There is a fire inside you, burning for fish. More fish. Bigger fish. It is time to feed that fire.

自分の成長を実感してみたいわよね？
